---
title: "STACK backend contract"
---

CTM STACK builds one card shell in Lua. `cas: sympy` is the provisional default;
`cas: maxima` stops the build until its backend is installed. A mixed-backend
page is noted once at build time. Each backend generates its own variants:
SymPy seeds use Python's RNG and do not reproduce Moodle's deployed seeds.

The version-2 JSON island contains `common` input/qtest/checker data,
`backend.question` and per-variant `plan` data that the controller treats as
opaque, display HTML, and `{n, id, hash}` identities. `stackRevision` reports the
engine's actual reference pin; SymPy's `runtimeHash` is null.

Each backend descriptor is `{id, version, adapter, requires: {isolation}}`.
The adapter URL is relative to the component script. Its script registers a
factory under `window.CTMStackAdapters[id]`, returning:

- `start()`: a promise that resolves when requests may run;
- `request({type, question, variant, answers})`: a promise of `{ok, result}` or
  `{ok: false, error: {kind, code, message}}`;
- `stop(reason)`: stop this backend only; resolves with `{restarted}`;
- `restart(reason)`: start a new session for this backend;
- `isolationRequired`: whether this backend requires cross-origin isolation.

The controller has no backend-specific branch. It serializes requests per
backend, drops queued requests superseded by the same card/kind, and ignores
stale results after edits. The calculation clock starts after `start()`;
loading has its own bound. Stop keeps answers, interrupts first when the shared
runtime can do so, and otherwise restarts only the private backend. Runtime
errors offer Retry; author errors preserve the session. Invalid answers and
undecidable CAS tests remain ordinary results.

SymPy starts `CTMWorker` with `publish: false`, then loads SymPy and the STACK
checker part from the page. It never assigns or stops `mainPyodide`. Its
adapter normalizes ctm-checkers' additive `errorDetail` envelope. MathJax and
matrix input are shared page assets. Error and message arguments are data;
only backend-sanitized CASText HTML is inserted as HTML.

`stack:` settings include `cas`, `lang`, `feedback`, `stop-after`, `save`,
`source-panels`, and `validation`. The intended validation default is `instant`;
until the backend's bounded admission is shipped, SymPy uses the explicit
Validate button. API 2 is sufficient; `CTMStore` is probed at runtime. No-AI
builds have no feedback payload, button or gear. Exam delivery retains the
umbrella's Pyodide-only restrictions.
